title: How fast
summary: The speed of the beat has a name and a number.

steps.title: Tempo
steps.body:
How fast the beat goes is the **tempo**. A ballad has a slow tempo; a dance track has a fast one.

**Why it matters:** Bands agree the tempo before they start, and a drummer "counts in" at that tempo so everyone starts together.

steps.title: BPM
steps.body:
Tempo is measured in **BPM**, beats per minute. 60 BPM is one beat a second, like a clock. 120 BPM is two beats a second.

**Why it matters:** Metronomes, drum machines and recording apps all use BPM. "This one's about 90" means 90 BPM.

steps.title: Slow and fast
steps.body: 60 BPM is one beat a second. 120 BPM fits two beats in the same second.

items.prompt: Tap at 60 BPM, once each second: 4 taps.

steps.title: Guess the tempo
steps.body: Tap along with a song and count your taps for 15 seconds. Multiply by 4 and you have its BPM.

items.prompt: Which is faster: 60 BPM or 120 BPM?
